# Vendored validator

`validate_plugin_catalog.py` copied verbatim from `NousResearch/hermes-agent`
(`scripts/validate_plugin_catalog.py`), MIT-licensed, fetched 2026-09-19 at
upstream main commit `da2e571b981e`. It is the exact checker a plugin-catalog
PR must pass; executing it here catches entry-shape mistakes before that PR.

If upstream changes the checker, re-vendor deliberately and note it here.
